**Dropnook 1.0** — instant sharing for your home network, like AirDrop for every device.

* **Text fields and files, live on every device** — phone, laptop and PC, in the browser: no app, no login, no cloud. Uploads of any size, resumable, with progress for everyone.
* **Screenshots and pictures** — paste with Ctrl+V (⌘V), previews in the file list, a large view, and *Copy* puts the picture itself into the clipboard.
* **Share to the internet on your terms** — single files or texts through links that expire, optionally with a password, served by a separate, locked-down container. Drop itself is never reachable from the internet.
* **17 languages, light and dark.**
* **Tested before every release** — each image has to pass an automatic set of attacks before it is published, and is rebuilt every week for security updates.

Installation: [README](https://github.com/dropnook/dropnook.app#installation) · Website: [dropnook.app](https://dropnook.app/)
